rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when formally accepting someone into an organization as a member.

example.english: They formally induct him as a member of the society.
example.traditional: 學會正式接納佢做會員。
example.jyutping: hok6 wui5 zing3 sik1 zip3 naap6 keoi5 zou6 wui2 jyun4

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone is drafted into military service.

example.english: The government will induct him after graduation, and he will go to a military camp for training.
example.traditional: 佢畢業之後就會畀政府徵召入伍，去軍營受訓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 wui5 bei2 zing3 fu2 zing1 ziu6 jap6 ng5 heoi3 gwan1 jing4 sau6 fan3

rows.note: Use this when introducing someone to the practices or basic knowledge of a field, profession, or tradition.

example.english: The master helps induct me into the tea ceremony by teaching me how to taste tea.
example.traditional: 師傅帶我入門，教我點樣品茶。
example.jyutping: si1 fu2 daai2 ngo5 jap6 mun4 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng2 ban2 caa4
